title: Full-field memory-system matrix — published claims vs SME multipass (every survey system)
author: Cassia (sme-dreamteam)
posture: Diagnostic, not benchmark. Each cell is a controlled reading of one substrate under stated conditions; cross-system comparison on the structural cats carries the ontology-sensitivity confound the spec flags. N/A means 'the system has no structure to evaluate for this cat' (a finding, not a blank).

flat.label: BASELINE — no-structure control (the floor the structural delta is measured against; not a competitor)

rlm.label: DIAGNOSTIC ARM — Cat 9a orchestrator-invocation probe (measures the model in front of the memory, not a memory product)

full_context.label: BASELINE (Karpathy D1) — WIRED, NOT YET BENCHED

karpathy_compiled.label: BASELINE (Karpathy D2) — WIRED, NOT YET BENCHED

roles_note: Group labels so the matrix reads honestly: memory_system = an actual memory product under test (mempalace, OMEGA = substrates; Hindsight, Mem0 = extraction competitors). baseline_control = flat, the no-structure floor the structural delta is measured AGAINST. diagnostic_arm = rlm, the Cat 9a orchestrator probe (measures the MODEL's invocation behaviour, not a memory product). Wired-but-unbenched adapters (Karpathy D1/D2, oracle/random controls) are in not_benched_footnote, NOT given rows. Do NOT read this as '6 competing products' -- 4 systems + 1 control + 1 diagnostic arm.

scoreability_legend.scoreable: the cat is meaningfully runnable against this system
scoreability_legend.N/A-no-graph: system exposes no graph/edges; structural cat cannot be evaluated
scoreability_legend.N/A-no-harness: system is a pure library; no invocation surface to probe
scoreability_legend.ceiling-corpus-declared: edges were hand-declared by the corpus (good-dog-graph); the +1.00 is a ceiling case, not emergent detection (SUPERSEDED for mempalace by the emergent real-KG read; kept as the prior reading for the record)
scoreability_legend.emergent: edges were GENERATED by the system's own pipeline (not corpus-declared); the reading measures real emergent structure
scoreability_legend.verdict-exact-pending: [mempalace Cat5/8 SUPERSEDED 2026-05-31 by FINAL exact full-graph numbers -- see FINAL note] historically: adapter absolute number was sample/limit-dependent, verdict published pending a server-side computation.
scoreability_legend.pending-adapter: adapter not yet merged to main; slot reserved
scoreability_legend.verified-qa-deferred: adapter verified + runnable on the harness, but full on-harness QA is DEFERRED because the system is extraction-throughput-bound (an LLM fact-extraction per session ingest makes a strat150 run take many hours); we record the field-reported number + the deferral reason, NOT an on-harness QA number
scoreability_legend.N/A-no-graph-endpoint: system exposes no usable typed-edge graph; the adapter's snapshot has no edges, so structural cats cannot be evaluated. Two distinct causes seen: Hindsight serves no graph endpoint at all (extraction-then-retrieve); Mem0 OSS *removed* its graph-memory layer (now flat/vector) -- noted per-cell.
scoreability_legend.not-run: adapter is wired into the harness registry but was NOT run through this cat -- no baseline reading exists. An honest coverage gap, not a score of 0.
scoreability_legend.N/A-by-design: the system has no structure to evaluate BY DESIGN -- it is the no-structure control (flat vector retrieval). Structural cats are N/A for a different reason than the competitors: there is intentionally no graph, it's the baseline the structural delta is measured AGAINST.

hindsight.note: Adapter VERIFIED + runnable on our harness (#220/#184); the phi4-vs-qwen JSON-extraction catch resolved (reasoning model required for strict-JSON extraction, like OMEGA's bge catch). On-harness QA/R@5 DEFERRED: Hindsight runs an LLM fact-extraction per session ingest (~60-96s/session here) -> strat150 ingest alone ~150h. Field-reported 91.4% LongMemEval QA is its own leaderboard (GPT-4.1-class extraction+reader), NOT an on-harness number. One n=12 indicative attempt was INVALIDATED by mid-run container SIGTERM (box cleanup, not OOM) and is NOT published -- it measured a dead server, not Hindsight.

mem0.note: Adapter VERIFIED vs real mem0ai 2.0.4 (from_config/add/search) + live smoke GREEN on a local $0-cloud stack (ollama phi4 extractor + nomic-embed-text). On-harness QA DEFERRED: extraction-throughput-bound -- warm steady-state ~9s/ingest -> strat150 ingest ~18h CPU-local (same wall as Hindsight). Extraction is LOSSY by design (smoke stored 3/5 facts). No on-harness QA number slotted.

mempalace.note: Cat 9a tracks the ORCHESTRATOR's Tau2 score, not the substrate. opus-4-8 -> 100% invocation / 98.3% recall on the daemon retrieval path.

omega.note: OMEGA is a pure Python library (and an MCP server, not exercised here). Cat 9a measures whether an ORCHESTRATOR model invokes the memory tool; that is an orchestrator-model property, not a substrate property. On this harness OMEGA was driven via its library API (no model-in-the-loop), so 9a is N/A for the substrate -- the same way mempalace's 9a number is really a property of the opus-4-8 orchestrator in front of it, not of mempalace.

rlm.note: THE RLM finding: Qwen-7B and Llama-70B both plateau at 46.7% recall with 7-27% tool-invocation -- the ceiling is WILLINGNESS TO INVOKE, not retrieval. comparability_caveats.R@K_vs_QA: R@5 retrieval recall (MemPalace upstream, agentmemory, engram-2, ai-memory, mcp-memory-service) is NOT comparable to E2E QA accuracy (OMEGA, Mem0, Hindsight, True Memory, EverOS, Zep, Supermemory). Celiums proved 100% retrieval can = 62.3% QA. (survey §3)
comparability_caveats.answer_model_swing: ~24pp swing on the SAME benchmark between answer models (GPT-4.1 95.4% vs GPT-4o-mini 71.4%). No apples-to-apples QA exists unless the answer model is held constant. (survey §3)
comparability_caveats.platform_vs_oss: Mem0's 92-94% are the CLOUD platform v3 (new alg); the OSS package is 61-68% LoCoMo. Survey: 'almost never made explicit.' Label every Mem0 number platform-vs-OSS.
comparability_caveats.locomo_subset: LoCoMo question count varies (~1,540 full vs 200/300 subsets); adversarial category often skipped (Hindsight skips it); engram-2 uses a NON-STANDARD strict GPT-5.4 judge. LoCoMo cross-comparisons unreliable without exact subset+judge. (survey §3)
comparability_caveats.judge_variation: Most use GPT-4o judge (LongMemEval protocol); engram-2 strict GPT-5.4, EverMind GPT-OSS-120b@temp0. Not interchangeable.
comparability_caveats.mempalace_upstream_controversy: Upstream 96.6% R@5 is a ChromaDB baseline (no palace features; enabling them HURTS: rooms -7.2pp, AAAK -12.4pp; BM25 alone 93.8%); LoCoMo 100% is structurally guaranteed at top-50. The fork publishes 0.984 R@5 held-out (no E2E QA). (survey §'MemPalace Upstream Benchmark Controversy')
